producer_report.summary: `athena status` now prints `self-queued fixes  last 7d: N queued, M run · total: N queued, M run`. It always prints, with zeros when there are none. It counts requests on `steward::REQUEST_CHANNEL`, by `received_at` against the current time. A job still queued, proposed or declined counts as queued. Any other state counts as run, including Closed, Dispatched and Blocked. The counts come from the new `SelfQueued` in `status.rs`, a new `self_queued` field on `StatusView`, and one `writeln!` in `crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs`. Three new unit tests passed under `cargo test -p athena-core status`, and a CHANGELOG entry is added. I did not run the full `cargo test`, clippy or fmt; those are left to Athena.

checks_run.note: all status tests in the CLI crate passed

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs builds records with steward-channel and cli-channel requests, some inside and some outside 7 days, some run and some still queued. The test asserts the rendered line shows the right counts for the last 7 days and in total, and that cli-channel requests are not counted. Verify by running `cargo test -p athena-core status`.
criteria_check.evidence: status::self_queued_tests::counts_steward_requests_by_week_and_total_and_ignores_cli_requests builds 6 steward and 2 cli jobs, inside and outside 7 days, run and queued. It asserts the line `last 7d: 2 queued, 1 run · total: 3 queued, 3 run`. It passed under `cargo test -p athena-core status`. A second test pins the 7-day boundary.

criteria_check.criterion: With no steward-queued requests, the line still prints with zeros (for example 0 queued, 0 run), so an empty backlog shows as an explicit count and is not hidden. A unit test covers this and is run with `cargo test -p athena-core status`.
criteria_check.evidence: status::self_queued_tests::with_no_steward_requests_the_line_prints_zeros asserts the all-zero line for empty records and for cli-only records. It passed. display.rs prints the line unconditionally.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff to crates/athena-core/src/status.rs adds a line to the `athena status` text output. It reads like `self-queued fixes  last 7d: N queued, M run · total: N queued, M run` and reports both the queued and run counts for both windows. It counts only requests whose channel is steward::REQUEST_CHANNEL, not a duplicated literal.
criteria_check.evidence: status.rs adds SelfQueued::compute and SelfQueued::text. compute filters on crate::steward::REQUEST_CHANNEL. display.rs, in athena-cli, prints text() in the status output. The Hestia request path in hestia.rs also uses REQUEST_CHANNEL.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check` pass. Existing status tests and the xtask spec tests that check status labels still pass, with the Hestia spec_gaps label check updated if it applies.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full cargo test, clippy and fmt. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core status`, which includes every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line, and `cargo test -p athena-cli status`. Both passed. The new line is not a spec measure label, so the spec_gaps check needs no change.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry recording the new status line.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md has a new `### Added` entry under Unreleased describing the line, the counting rule and the tests.

open_issues: A self-queued request that a person closed with `athena close` before it ever ran is counted as run, because it left the queued, proposed and declined states. The count cannot tell that apart from a job that ran.
mistakes: The first test build failed because Request was not imported in the new test module. I fixed it.
learnings: The status text is rendered in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, not in status.rs or main.rs.
Hestia requests use steward::REQUEST_CHANNEL (hestia.rs queues with it).
The producer's Bash hook rejects heredocs and tail/wc/grep, so use the Edit tool for file changes.
